name: hackathon-kit
description: From a hackathon challenge statement to a team ready to code: analysis, approaches to choose from, repo scaffolding, a per-person plan, a pitch outline and a check against the source. Optional Hackathon OS: shared team status, collision warnings, a local work web for each person and, optionally, jury coverage, critical-path views and structural-merge collision checks with Mergiraf (level 2b).
